# Northfield Combi Boiler Guide

This guide covers the Northfield C30 combi boiler used in the test corpus.

## Error codes

### F28 ignition failure

F28 means the boiler tried to light five times and failed. Check that the gas supply is on at the meter and that other gas appliances work. Press reset once. If F28 returns, book an engineer; do not keep resetting.

### F22 low pressure

F22 means system pressure is below 0.5 bar. Top up using the filling loop until the gauge reads between 1.0 and 1.5 bar, then close the loop.

## Annual service

A Gas Safe engineer should service the boiler every 12 months. The service includes a flue gas analysis, a check of the condensate trap, and a pressure test of the expansion vessel.
